title: Glowing snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glowSnow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#dff2ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8d8f0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glowHalo' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bff0ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#bff0ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow halo behind snowman -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='44' fill='url(#glowHalo)'/>

  <!-- bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='21' fill='url(#glowSnow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='78' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='15.5' fill='url(#glowSnow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='50' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- head snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='12.5' fill='url(#glowSnow)'/>

  <!-- scarf around neck -->
  <rect x='38' y='42' width='24' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e83f4f'/>
  <path d='M59 44 L67 50 L64 57 L58 52 Z' fill='#c22a3a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='47' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff7a86'/>

  <!-- hat -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21.5' rx='17' ry='4' fill='#3b6fd4'/>
  <path d='M38 21 L40 6 L60 6 L62 21 Z' fill='#4a7fe6'/>
  <rect x='38' y='17' width='24' height='4.5' fill='#7fb0ff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='7' width='8' height='8' rx='2' fill='#a8c8ff'/>

  <!-- eyes: coal -> glowing amber -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='1.9' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='30' r='1.9' fill='#ffd24a'/>

  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <path d='M50 34 L42 36.5 L50 38 Z' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <path d='M50 34.5 L45 36.3 L50 37.3 Z' fill='#ffb04d'/>

  <!-- smile of glowing coals -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1.4' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='41' r='1.4' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='41' r='1.4' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='39' r='1.4' fill='#ffd24a'/>

  <!-- buttons on middle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='1.8' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='1.8' fill='#ffd24a'/>

  <!-- little twig arms -->
  <path d='M36 52 L26 46 M32 49 L29 55' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M64 52 L74 46 M68 49 L71 55' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
</svg>
